initial_approved_plan.scene: Cream cheese box and butter on a table beside an open woven basket.

action.belief: Both target packs are on the table: cream cheese beside the juice at image left, and butter beside the milk near the center. The basket is to the right. The hand is open and empty; target coordinates are preliminary RGB estimates.
action.plan: Pick the cream cheese first, carry it above the basket rim, and lower and release inside; then repeat for the butter. Approach above the cream cheese for a closer grasp view.
action.why: A high approach provides a closer wrist view while avoiding the neighboring cartons.

action.belief: No movement occurred because the requested displacement slightly exceeded the 0.30 m stage envelope. The scene and grasp estimate are unchanged.
action.plan: Split the cream-cheese approach into a high lateral move and a vertical descent.
action.why: The intermediate waypoint keeps each stage within its motion envelope and maintains clearance above the cartons.

action.belief: The closer view shows the cream-cheese box clearly, with its long axis approximately world X. Two-view geometry places its center near [0.079,-0.218] and top near z=0.45 m. The open jaws can straddle its narrower Y dimension.
action.plan: Align above the box, descend slowly to its sides, close, and make a small test lift before carrying.
action.why: The updated alignment corrects the initial estimate; the lift checkpoint will distinguish a grasp from empty closure.

action.belief: The descent stalled about 5 mm above the selected height, so I will not push farther. The box remains centered between the open fingers in both views; closing at the present height may still engage its side faces. Attachment is unverified.
action.plan: Close at the current measured pose and lift only 4 cm to inspect whether the cream cheese follows.
action.why: This avoids further downward pressure and directly tests the plausible grasp at the reached height.

action.belief: The cream-cheese box rose with the hand and remains between the fingers; the 42 mm gap is consistent with its width. This is good visual evidence of a successful grasp. The basket opening still needs a closer overhead alignment view.
action.plan: Lift above the cartons and basket rim, then carry through high waypoints to above the basket. Inspect before descending.
action.why: The high route avoids neighboring packages and obtains a usable view of the basket interior.

action.belief: The cream cheese remains securely carried above the basket. The wrist view shows the opening beneath it, with room to center the whole box slightly farther toward world -X. The basket floor height is less certain than the rim.
action.plan: Center the box inside the opening, lower below the rim to a conservative release height, open, and withdraw for a clear support check.
action.why: Centering and a vertical insertion keep the box away from the woven walls; withdrawal exposes its settled pose.

action.belief: The box is fully over the basket cavity, but descent slowed and exhausted its budget near z=0.581 m. The hand may be encountering the rim, so deeper insertion is not justified. The box itself has a clear downward path into the lining.
action.plan: Release from the reached height, then lift the empty hand to inspect the box's settled location before picking the butter.
action.why: Opening avoids forcing the hand farther into the basket and allows the centered box to settle inside.

action.belief: The cream-cheese box is now visibly resting wholly inside the basket, separate from the open hand. The butter remains on the table near world [0.035,0.069], with a narrow Y dimension suitable for the same top grasp.
action.plan: Leave the cream cheese undisturbed and approach above the butter for a closer alignment check.
action.why: This advances the remaining object while preserving the completed basket placement.

action.belief: The butter is centered slightly toward world -Y from the hand. Its top is approximately z=0.456 m, and its long axis is world X. The grasp corridor is clear of the nearby can and basket wall.
action.plan: Align to [0.036,0.062], descend to the butter's sides, close, and test-lift 4 cm.
action.why: A small corrected alignment and monitored lift provide evidence of attachment before transport.

action.belief: The butter lifted from the table with the fingers and remains aligned in the wrist view. The approximately 39 mm gap supports the visual grasp evidence. The cream cheese remains in the basket.
action.plan: Lift clear of the rim, carry the butter above an adjacent area inside the basket, then inspect before releasing.
action.why: The elevated route avoids the basket wall and keeps the butter separated from the already placed cream cheese.

action.belief: The butter is still held over the basket, beside the cream cheese. It is close to the outer side of the opening, so a 1 cm inward adjustment improves whole-object clearance. The previous insertion encountered resistance below about z=0.58 m.
action.plan: Shift inward, lower only to z=0.595 m, release into the cavity, and withdraw to inspect both objects.
action.why: This keeps the butter inside the rim while avoiding another deep-hand insertion and preserving the cream-cheese placement.
